purpose: Collect land listings before screening. Preserve every record and disposition. Work state by state, county by county; retain unresolved sources and unfinished review queues.
scope: 50 states and District of Columbia; all land categories and price bands. No national completeness claim without a reconciled defined source universe. Feed snapshots and dates matter.

storage.write: POST JSON {run_id,producer_id,summary,coverage,records:[{kind,id,expected_version:0,data:{...}}]}. Up to 100 rows. New rows version 0; updates must use GET version. Use stable source-and-listing IDs. A different correction gets a new run_id.
storage.receipt: Each atomic write retains prior data, returns payload hash and readback_verified. Reuse identical run_id/payload after a transient failure; do not alter a retry. GET the run receipt and representative record before advancing coverage/cursors.
storage.service_auth: Call Sites get_site with exact project_id. Verify owner-only audience. Obtain siwc_bypass_bearer_token from that result and send OAI-Sites-Authorization: Bearer TOKEN only to the exact Site origin. The token supplies no user identity. Keep it only in memory and stdin; never store in prompts, source or output. No invented identity headers. If unsupported, use the connected Site MCP publish_origination_batch/get_origination_registry tools, or disclose blocked delivery and save an import-ready payload. Do not republish for ordinary data writes.

residential.measurements: Parcel boundary to nearest confirmed dwelling; separately nearest potential dwelling; proposed equipment/pad to receptors if layout exists. Count confirmed dwellings in 250,500,1000 metres and 1 mile. Record units, projection, imagery date, layer source, confidence and completeness. Boundary-to-boundary distance required where local rule uses sensitive properties. Distinguish on-site seller dwelling and off-site homes. Do not convert a parcel centroid distance to a setback.
residential.flags: Residential subdivisions including approved/unbuilt lots, schools, hospitals, care facilities, churches, campgrounds where relevant; multiple sides of homes; prevailing wind/topography/vegetation, sound/cooling/generators/emissions/light/traffic; usable buffer and expansion envelope.
residential.policy: Distance bands are prioritization only, not nationwide zoning law or calibrated approval odds. Known binding rule failure may reject current scope; proximity alone triggers evidence and mitigation review. Missing measurements are null, never zero or 'no residences'.

approval_history.record: Correct county/municipality/township/ETJ authority; case/root project ID, APNs, use (crypto/data center/industrial), MW, date, stage, vote, decision, conditions, denial/withdrawal rationale, residential relation, ordinance at time/current, appeal/litigation/reversal/expiry, source URL and completeness window.
approval_history.outcomes: Separate rezoning, CUP, site plan, permit, recommendation, denial, withdrawal, pending, registration and moratorium. Construction registration is not zoning approval. No cases found is unknown, not supportive.
approval_history.inference: Compare truly similar scope and legal regime. Do not derive approval percentage from selected cases, synthetic labels or announced successes.

review.rules: Preserve 52-factor register, 34-topic/116-question diligence, 16 non-compensating paid-control proofs. 10-50MW focus, especially 20-30 facility MW, does not filter raw intake. Existing one paid pilot/two backups constrains spending, not number of research listings. $5,000 learning and $10,000 cumulative initial soft-control caps remain; no new spending authorized.
review.dispositions: REJECT requires supported reason scoped to specific use and phase; tiny lot may fail standalone design but assembly remains an explicit reopening condition. HOLD for missing evidence/technical access/current-status conflict. FURTHER_INVESTIGATION is research priority, not powered or permit-ready.
review.learning: Preserve all rejected/held records, evidence, reason category, reviewer/method version, changed conditions and source dates. Distinguish analyst labels from observed permit/utility/seller/buyer outcomes; no model training or calibrated probabilities claimed merely by saving rows. Recheck changed conditions, audit false negatives.

coverage.county_completion: A Census county record is not a review. Complete only for named source universe and snapshot after every page/cursor and record count reconcile and every ingested listing is individually reviewed. Never label that all-source completeness if independent broker/MLS/off-market universe unresolved.
coverage.cursors: Maintain per-source state/county query/filter/page/cursor, attempted and successful intervals, known denominators, returned/deduped/reviewed counts, failure and next URL. Advance committed watermark only after durable receipt. First-seen is not first-listed. National newest sitemap has limited window, not an exhaustive feed.
coverage.backfill: Alphabetical state order, then county FIPS, starting Alabama/Autauga 01001. Keep blocked source explicit; attempt meaningful alternate authorized sources and advance working queue while retaining unfinished status. Never repeatedly restart Alabama. Daily delta is separate so backfill does not miss new supply.

daily_output: Always deliver an auditable progress report: new/changed/individually reviewed counts, current dispositions with reasons, residence and approval-history evidence added, source/county coverage, unresolved gaps, next cursor and verified Deal Desk receipt. Zero qualified candidates still requires a progress report.
safety: No contact, account creation, purchase, offers, commitments or paid data activation. Existing user-confirmed written LandSearch permission dated 2026-09-30 remains recognized; respect technical access controls and provider limits. No .html deliverables.
record_id_contract: POST id accepts a bare stable ID or a qualified registry_id. The writer removes redundant kind prefixes for new records and resolves existing legacy keys without renaming rows or history. GET kind+id resolves the same aliases. Use the returned version as expected_version. Existing aliases must not be duplicated under a newly normalized key. Legacy run retries retain their original receipts.
